diagnosis_and_fix.root_cause: During FE deploy run 39274970062 (under Root 39266905540), both candidate (84fbe157bee67793d8f585d128e47c30525a35ce) and previous rollback target (4e5bbe67349c51b8b0cca8c4d8fa81a5371f873a) passed prepare pre-switch browser probes, and candidate passed activate pre-switch probe. When re-probing previous_target_pre_switch during activate at 2026-04-10T15:26:21Z, Chromium encountered a transient network interface change (net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED) while fetching /bff/me and /bff/auth/readiness, while manifest, assets, index SHA-256, CORS preflight, and write-route checks all passed. run_release_probe in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh had no bounded retry for a pure Chromium ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED pre-switch probe failure.
diagnosis_and_fix.fix_summary: Added exported classifier isTransientNetworkChangedProbeFailure(evidence) in scripts/probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs (and recorded transientNetworkChangedOnly in probe JSON output) that returns true only when a failed probe passed all non-core-request checks (manifest, index/assets, CORS preflight, zero page/write/retired-endpoint violations, no unsafe auth redirect) and every failed core BFF request failed with status 0 and error containing ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED (plus matching requestFailures entries). Updated run_release_probe in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh so pre-switch phases (*_pre_switch) allow at most one complete re-probe with the exact same environment and release/backend/pair identities when attempt 1 fails with isTransientNetworkChangedProbeFailure. Preserved original attempt 1 evidence at browser-probe-<phase>-attempt-1.json and append-only event browser.probe.<phase>.attempt_1 (failed) distinct from final browser-probe-<phase>.json and browser.probe.<phase> (passed or failed).
